summary_1line: Shatananda praises Vishwamitra to Rama and begins recounting the sage’s royal past and his visit as king to the hermitage of Vasistha.

image_candidates.scene_text: Shatananda, radiant with ascetic power, addresses Rama and Lakshmana seated beside Vishwamitra in the quiet forest hermitage.
King Vishwamitra with his army arrives at the serene hermitage of Vasistha, filled with sages, deer, and birds among dense trees.
The hermitage of Vasistha glows with ascetics performing rituals around sacred fires while peaceful deer wander and birds circle above.
